summary: John's maternal 5th great-grandfather; with Felicita Magnotta the earliest known ancestors in Guardia Lombardi.
bio: Tree: Pietro Dimarino (1760-1808) + Felicia Magnotta (1760-1808). Round 1 flagged the identical dates as probably copied or invented. Round 3 confirmed the couple's names from son Gaetano's death act (Morti 1876 act 20). Married before about 1796. Di Marino: 6 US arrivals from Guardia 1830-1912 (paese.app).
openQuestions: Verify 1808 death (Guardia Morti 1809+ would not cover 1808; parish records)
